title: Borrowing two elements mutably at once
prompt: What error occurs when attempting `let a = &mut slice[0]` and `let b = &mut slice[1]` in the same scope, and why?
answer: The compiler raises error `E0499` for borrowing `slice` as mutable more than once. Indexing calls a method that borrows the whole slice mutably, so Rust cannot statically verify that the two indices do not overlap.
